stages.label: States loaded
stages.narrative: Pinned state vectors, frames, epochs, bounds, and solver tolerances define the search.

stages.label: Candidates searched
stages.narrative: Lambert branches converge, fail numerically, or violate declared constraints.

stages.label: Transfer verified
stages.narrative: Independent propagation measures endpoint position and velocity error for the selected candidate.

stages.label: Flight visualized
stages.narrative: The verified screening trajectory advances separately from solver selection and Hohmann baseline.

seeds.label: Earth to Mars launch window
seeds.description: Search a bounded Earth-to-Mars departure and time-of-flight grid.

seeds.label: Earth to Moon cargo
seeds.description: Compare a bounded short-duration Earth-to-Moon transfer scenario.

seeds.label: Earth to Venus launch window
seeds.description: Search a bounded Earth-to-Venus departure and time-of-flight grid on the pinned JPL Horizons vectors.

seeds.label: Earth to Jupiter transfer window
seeds.description: Search a bounded direct Earth-to-Jupiter two-body transfer; no gravity assist is modeled.
